items.name: Buying from Abroad
items.description: Steps to purchase while you are outside Egypt, and viewing the unit remotely.
items.intro:
Buying a property in Egypt while you are outside of it requires a different arrangement than direct purchasing, from remotely viewing the unit to payment and handover of the property.

In this section, we explain the steps one by one, so you know what you can do yourself and what you can delegate to others.
items.cta: Do you want a purchase plan that suits your presence outside Egypt?

items.name: Power of attorney and documents
items.description: The official power of attorney, and the documents you need before and after signing.
items.intro:
The official power of attorney is one of the most important documents that anyone who buys a property in Egypt and is away from it needs, as it allows a person you trust to sign or receive on your behalf. 

In this section, we explain the types of powers of attorney, the documents required before and after signing, and how to avoid common mistakes.
items.cta: Do you need clarification on the power of attorney steps before signing?

items.name: Payment and Transfer
items.description: Payment from abroad, money transfer, and installment plans for expats.
items.intro:
Paying for a property in Egypt while you are outside of it has its own set of questions: how to transfer funds safely, what you pay and when, and whether the installment plan suits you.

In this section, we explain the payment and transfer methods step by step, so you know what to ensure before sending any amount.
items.cta: Do you want to know the best way to pay from abroad?

items.name: Investing from a distance
items.description: Renting your unit and managing it while you are traveling, and calculating the return.
items.intro:
Owning a property in Egypt can be an investment, but it requires management and you are far away: from renting the unit and following up on the tenant, to calculating the actual return after expenses

In this section, we explain how to manage your property remotely, and how to estimate its return with realistic numbers before you decide.
items.cta: Do you want to review the yield account before you decide?

items.name: Selecting the unit
items.description: How to choose a unit that suits your return or your family in Egypt.
items.intro: Choosing a unit while you are away from it is a decision that requires caution: where is the unit located? Does it suit your family or your return? And what should you make sure of before you pay? In this section, we explain the selection criteria and the questions you ask the developer or the owner, to choose a unit that really suits you.
items.cta: Are you confused about choosing the right unit for your family?
